samples.text: The head of state of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea stated that "Our national sovereignty and security have firmly been ensured by virtue of a great strength so far and will invariably be so in the years ahead. The DPRK's nuclear deterrent is the absolute might and irresistible force designed from A to Z to safeguard the sovereignty, security, and peace against aggression and threat from outside. I'd like to reiterate the official position of the DPRK government, the status of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea as a nuclear weapons state, that has been uncompromisingly and permanently fixed both physically and legally with absolutely no turning point, can never be reversed in any circumstances or by any means, no matter how hard and loudly the hostile forces may deny in chorus with all sorts of rhetoric. The DPRK will continue to strictly control and manage every external threat by dint of its supremacy in overwhelming strength, and be all the more faithful and committed to our mission as a responsible nuclear weapons state to firmly defend the national sovereignty and fundamental interests and to guarantee peace and security of the region and beyond. Mr. President, Large-scale natural calamities claimed tens of thousands of lives in different parts of the world this year. The international community came to realize once again that climate change is a pressing issue that calls for joint action. Artificial intelligence and other new cutting-edge technology are transforming every domain of human life, offering great opportunities, but at the same time, they also carry risks of being misused for sinister purposes. Highly volatile present era urgently calls for a strengthened UN, capable of handling challenges and crises facing humanity in conformity with the common interest of mankind.
